definitions: The ability to recall images, sounds, or objects with extreme accuracy and vividness from memory, as if they were still being perceived.
A form of photographic memory, often more common in children, where a person can recall a visual image after only a short exposure with high fidelity.
examples: She has an eidetic memory for faces.
His eidetic memory allowed him to perfectly recreate the drawing.
Not everyone possesses an eidetic memory.
